# Python packages for asc-metadata.yml, the job that holds the App Store Connect
# API key (MR-2102). Every package, transitive ones included, is pinned to an
# exact version AND to the SHA-256 of its wheel, and the job installs with
# --require-hashes --only-binary=:all:, the same way workflow-lint.yml installs
# zizmor: a new release, or a replaced file on PyPI, cannot run with that key.
#
# Hashes cover the wheels pip can choose on the job's runner (ubuntu-24.04,
# x86_64, CPython 3.12): pure-Python, cp312 and abi3 manylinux x86_64. To bump,
# change the versions, resolve the set for that platform, e.g.
#   pip download --only-binary=:all: --python-version 3.12 --implementation cp \
#     --platform manylinux_2_34_x86_64 --platform manylinux_2_17_x86_64 \
#     -d /tmp/asc pyjwt cryptography requests
# and take each file's sha256 from https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json.

# Direct: the scripts import jwt (ES256 needs cryptography) and requests.
pyjwt==2.15.1 \
    --hash=sha256:42d59d631f7768a1028a64c7ff581a9bf7519804daf91fc5b6c56e30eec5e193
cryptography==50.0.2 \
    --hash=sha256:630ebfea3bf689d075f82316324ff7433dc447fe6bc1bfc76524b74b4a9567d2 \
    --hash=sha256:4061c0079120205fb760c58acab6443e217307dcf05e3702cf970e0689972856 \
    --hash=sha256:9dab55f57c74c3cad24c323bacbbd04be4705ba6eb0d92e920b1fc4837ed5079 \
    --hash=sha256:ee247f5c245c9a2fe7c8e2214e295918838e44e00a45a6718451e4004219e767 \
    --hash=sha256:f21e8a22c8605750c7af886bab299a363721264061b4ac0a30efb73cfd58efc5 \
    --hash=sha256:1981f1db4630889b9ef7803fadef12b056f428cb6b85c27ba57b774793b6093c
requests==2.34.2 \
    --hash=sha256:2a0d60c172f83ac6ab31e4554906c0f3b3588d37b5cb939b1c061f4907e278e0
